acceptedAnswer.text: No. It is a game that counts letters in names. It has no scientific basis and cannot predict a relationship.

mainEntity.name: How is the love percentage worked out?

acceptedAnswer.text: It counts the letters L, O, V, E and S across the two names and the word "loves", then keeps adding neighbouring digits until two digits are left.

A paper-and-pencil game. Cancel the letters the two names share, count what is left, and use the count to remove letters from F L A M E S until one remains: Friends, Love, Affection, Marriage, Enemies or Siblings.

mainEntity.name: What are the five love languages?

acceptedAnswer.text: Words of affirmation, quality time, acts of service, physical touch and receiving gifts. The idea comes from Gary Chapman. Studies have found limited evidence that matching them predicts satisfaction.

mainEntity.name: What really predicts a happy relationship?

acceptedAnswer.text: Research points to how couples handle disagreements, kindness and appreciation in daily life, and shared long-term goals.
